items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: in this band we had Bill Dogett who was on piano

ctx.x: Yeah, a saxophone soloist, and he had a pretty well-founded reputation, why, he got the job for being in the house band there. In fact, I lost a little bit of money in that band, because I used my own money that I had saved up to buy music and a music stand and the whole bit, you know?

And so after that, Willie Bryant reorganized a band, because he had been out of the band business, he was like a master of ceremonies, and he reorganized a band and in this band we had Bill Dogett who was on piano, and --
You went in Willie Bryant's band?
